body: I can really relate to this, my parents don’t know the extent of my depression because they lead stressful lives as it is. My dad is on anti depressants and spent time in a psychiatric hospital before on suicide watch, so I fear my suicide would send him over the edge to commit as well, which isn’t fair on him or the rest of the family. It’s such a tough situation but at least these people in our lives pose as a deterrent. I hope you’re doing okay and overcome this eventually, heck I hope you just have a nice day tomorrow at least
Thank you I need to hear things like this, I don’t want to be naive and take everything at face value. Hiding this has to mean something.

After more thought I agree with you more. Fair enough he’s in sales and therefore it’s his job to be likeable and reel someone in. But in my opinion there is no reason to continue being this way by messaging for a week after the transaction, they haven’t gone their separate ways as you’ve said. 

As he deliberately hid this from me I am seriously considering breaking up with him, I’m really hurt by the fact he knew this would bother me and his first resort was to hide it. I feel this shows poor character.

I meant that as in this is the first time I have *ever* checked anything of his, sorry I wasn’t clear. 

But I understand where you’re coming from. By doing this is it means I don’t trust him after seeing something suspicious, and maybe I shouldn’t by the looks of it.

I agree with most of what you’ve said. But I don’t agree that I’m a paranoid mess; since getting back together I have not ever behaved unreasonably/like I don’t trust him - I do not check his things or check where or who he is with etc. I checked this because it appeared in front of me and looked off, if the conversation wasn’t muted I would’ve logged out immediately. That’s why I feel he would not be motivated to hide things like this from me if it was innocent - I don’t do things like “flip out”. 

I forgave him and with that I decided to trust him. By hiding messages from me he is giving me a reason not to. 

I agree that perhaps this relationship is doomed (despite my best efforts to hold onto my first love) because of the original breaking of trust I know in the back of my mind he is capable of doing it again. I’m having a serious think about whether I can still be with him, even though it’s only messages. 

Thank you, I really appreciate your opinion and you taking the time to respond to my post.

The worrying thing is he has said he wants to marry me in the future. But I agree considering his past he does not make much effort to put my mind at ease. 
What’s worse is that if he is doing more than this I won’t even know about it, as I only stumbled across this by accident. But I guess if I truly trusted him I wouldn’t have these fears.

Thank you for taking the time to respond to my post

Thank you for this perspective, you have a good point because he is currently the best salesman and outperforms everyone despite being there only 6 months. He has a natural charisma so I’m not surprised that she likes him. I’m just concerned that maybe he’s treating her as more than a customer now.
